evidence.title: HelaBERT: Enhancing Sinhala Language Understanding with Dual Pooling Classification Head

summary: Researchers unveil HelaBERT, a new model improving Sinhala language understanding through a dual pooling classification head. The innovation aims to enhance natural language processing for the Sinhala-speaking population.
title: HelaBERT Introduces Dual Pooling Classification Head to Advance Sinhala Language AI
